technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish technicals (Hull flip, three white soldiers, RSI rising) conflicted by intermediate bearish structure (price below 50-day MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud) and overbought oscillators in neutral sector—moderate risk swing entry.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 2 days present elevated volatility risk with weak fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed party, moderate to large amounts, 253-265 days stale
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-like 30 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite stale congressional selling and absent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 2 days creates compounded downside risk for AOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, three white soldiers, and SMA 9/21 bullish crossover signal short-term momentum reversal in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) offering contrarian entry near support at 47.05.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 2 days, price below both 50-day MAs, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, overbought oscillators, inverted yield curve, and zero fundamental conviction create compounded tail risk that overwhelms technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows short-term momentum (Hull flip, three white soldiers) at support in extreme fear environment, but earnings binary in 2 days combined with price below 50-day MAs and negative MACD create unacceptable risk/reward for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 2 days will likely gap price sharply in either direction, invalidating technical setup and triggering stop-loss before mean reversion can develop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 5 positions in Industrials sector; adding AOS increases concentration risk without fundamental conviction to justify it.
